![Logo](img/favicon_small.png) Fifteen Puzzle Game ============= Move tiles in grid to order them from 1 to 15! Play classic Fifteen Puzzle Game [here](http://lorecioni.github.io/fifteen-puzzle-game "Fifteen Puzzle Game"). Description ---------- The 15-puzzle (also called Gem Puzzle, Boss Puzzle, Game of Fifteen, Mystic Square and many others) is a sliding puzzle that consists of a frame of numbered square tiles in random order with one tile missing.
